testcase.system-out: Scenario: Decline removal of duplicate model-state member names ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State ✔ And the user creates a fourth model state named Model State1 and reactivates Copy State ✔ And the user opens the model-state table ✔ And The MCAD Software has a model-state table with members Capture State and Model State1 ✔ When the user changes the Model State1 member cell to "Capture State" and presses Enter ✔ Then both matching member-name cells are highlighted yellow ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user selects OK ✔ Then a warning identifies the duplicate name and says duplicates will be removed if the user continues ✔ And the warning offers Yes and No ✔ When the user selects No ✔ Then the table remains open with both duplicate names highlighted ✔ When the user cancels the table ✔ Then the table closes without accepting the rename
